default.tagline: The definitive domain name for Financial Technologies.
default.heroSupport: A rare category keyword paired with the .contact TLD — built for trust, acquisition, and lasting brand authority in global fintech.

valueProps.title: Exact-match category authority
valueProps.body: “Fintech” is the universal shorthand for financial technologies. Owning fintech.contact places your brand at the linguistic center of payments, banking, lending, wealth, and financial infrastructure.

valueProps.title: Built-in call to action
valueProps.body: The .contact extension turns the domain into an invitation. Visitors understand the purpose immediately — reach the right team, open a dialogue, or start a partnership — without explanation.

valueProps.title: Premium brand equity
valueProps.body: Short, memorable, and globally pronounceable. Ideal for enterprise email, investor materials, conference sponsorship, and product marketing where first impressions compound.

valueProps.title: SEO & discovery advantage
valueProps.body: Search intent around financial technologies is durable and high-value. A domain that literally names the category strengthens branding, recall, and trust signals across every channel you operate.

useCases.title: Neobanks & digital finance

useCases.title: Enterprise contact hub

seoPoints.title: Keyword in the name
seoPoints.body: fintech.contact embeds the industry’s primary search term in the hostname itself — the strongest possible on-brand signal for financial technologies.

seoPoints.title: Memorable & type-in ready
seoPoints.body: Prospects, partners, and press can recall and type the domain without campaigns, shortening the path from awareness to contact.

seoPoints.title: Trust at the edge
seoPoints.body: Deployed on Cloudflare’s global network, the site loads fast worldwide — reinforcing the premium positioning of the asset.
